title.zh: 修正第939号法案（题为“将拉古纳省三十个市镇减至十九个”的法案）与第942号法案（题为“将黎刹省三十二个市镇减至十五个”的法案），并规定变更拉古纳省与黎刹省边界线，使原属黎刹省的蒙廷卢帕市镇划归拉古纳省的法案
title.en: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED NINE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-NINE, ENTITLED "AN ACT REDUCING THE THIRTY MUNICIPALITIES OF THE PROVINCE OF LA LAGUNA TO NINETEEN," AND ACT NUMBERED NINE HUNDRED AND FORTY-TWO, ENTITLED "AN ACT REDUCING THE THIRTY-TWO MUNICIPALITIES OF THE PROVINCE OF RIZAL TO FIFTEEN," AND PROVIDING THAT THE BOUNDARY LINE BETWEEN THE PROVINCES OF LA LAGUNA AND RIZAL BE CHANGED SO AS TO INCLUDE IN LA LAGUNA THE MUNICIPALITY OF MUNTINLUPA NOW A PART OF RIZAL.
title.orig: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED NINE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-NINE, ENTITLED "AN ACT REDUCING THE THIRTY MUNICIPALITIES OF THE PROVINCE OF LA LAGUNA TO NINETEEN," AND ACT NUMBERED NINE HUNDRED AND FORTY-TWO, ENTITLED "AN ACT REDUCING THE THIRTY-TWO MUNICIPALITIES OF THE PROVINCE OF RIZAL TO FIFTEEN," AND PROVIDING THAT THE BOUNDARY LINE BETWEEN THE PROVINCES OF LA LAGUNA AND RIZAL BE CHANGED SO AS TO INCLUDE IN LA LAGUNA THE MUNICIPALITY OF MUNTINLUPA NOW A PART OF RIZAL.
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Đạo luật Số 939 về giảm số lượng đô thị ở Tỉnh La Laguna từ ba mươi xuống mười chín và Đạo luật Số 942 về giảm số lượng đô thị ở Tỉnh Rizal từ ba mươi hai xuống mười lăm, đồng thời điều chỉnh đường ranh giới giữa hai tỉnh để đưa đô thị Muntinlupa hiện thuộc Tỉnh Rizal vào Tỉnh La Laguna
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่ 939 ว่าด้วยการลดจำนวนเทศบาลในจังหวัดลาลากูนาจากสามสิบแห่งเป็นสิบเก้าแห่ง และพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่ 942 ว่าด้วยการลดจำนวนเทศบาลในจังหวัดริซัลจากสามสิบสองแห่งเป็นสิบห้าแห่ง รวมทั้งกำหนดให้เปลี่ยนเส้นแบ่งเขตระหว่างจังหวัดลาลากูนาและจังหวัดริซัลเพื่อรวมเทศบาลมุนตินลูปาซึ่งขณะนี้อยู่ในจังหวัดริซัลเข้าไว้ในจังหวัดลาลากูนา
title.id: Undang-Undang tentang Perubahan Undang-Undang Nomor 939 mengenai Pengurangan Tiga Puluh Kotamadya di Provinsi La Laguna menjadi Sembilan Belas dan Undang-Undang Nomor 942 mengenai Pengurangan Tiga Puluh Dua Kotamadya di Provinsi Rizal menjadi Lima Belas, serta Penetapan Perubahan Garis Batas antara Provinsi La Laguna dan Provinsi Rizal agar Kotamadya Muntinlupa yang kini merupakan bagian dari Provinsi Rizal dimasukkan ke dalam Provinsi La Laguna
title.ms: Akta bagi Pindaan Akta Nombor 939 berkenaan Pengurangan Tiga Puluh Perbandaran di Wilayah La Laguna kepada Sembilan Belas dan Akta Nombor 942 berkenaan Pengurangan Tiga Puluh Dua Perbandaran di Wilayah Rizal kepada Lima Belas, serta Menetapkan Perubahan Garisan Sempadan antara Wilayah La Laguna dan Wilayah Rizal supaya Perbandaran Muntinlupa yang kini merupakan sebahagian daripada Wilayah Rizal dimasukkan ke dalam Wilayah La Laguna

text.en:
Act Numbered Nine hundred and thirty-nine, entitled "An Act reducing the thirty municipalities of
the Province of La Laguna to nineteen," is hereby amended as follows:
a. By striking out the words "and Pangil" in paragraph numbered two of section one.
b. By striking out the word "Paquil" in paragraph numbered three of section one.
c. By inserting after paragraph numbered three of section one the following new paragraph:
"3. 1/2 The municipality of Pangil shall consist of its present territory and that of the
municipality of Paquil, with the seat of the municipal government at the barrio of Balian, now a
part of the present municipality of Pangil."
d. By amending paragraph numbered seven so as to read as follows:
"7. The municipality of Los Baños shall consist of its present territory and that of the
municipality of Bay, with the seat of the municipal government at the present municipality of
e. By amending paragraph numbered eight so as to read as fallows:
"8. The municipality of Biñan shall consist of its present territory and that of the municipality
of San Pedro Tunasan, and of the municipality of Muntinlupa, heretofore a part of the Province

of Rizal and by section three of this Act made a part of the Province of La Laguna. The seat of
municipal government shall be at the present municipality of Biñan."
f. By striking out of the title and of section one of said Act, Numbered Nine hundred and thirty-
nine the word 'nineteen, and inserting in lieu thereof the word "twenty."
